questions.q: With whom did David consult before speaking to all the assembly of Israel?
questions.a: David consulted with the commanders and every leader in Israel.

questions.q: Why did the assembly of Israel agree to send messengers and bring the Box of God to them?
questions.a: The assembly agreed to do these things because they all thought it was the right thing to do.

questions.q: Where did David gather the people of Israel from to bring the Box of God?
questions.a: David gathered them from as far south as Shihor of Egypt to as far north as Lebo Hamath.

questions.q: Where did David and all Israel go to get the Box of God?
questions.a: They went to Baalah, that is, Kiriath Jearim.

questions.q: What did David and all Israel do as they brought the Box of God out of Abinadab’s house?
questions.a: David and all Israel celebrated before God with all their might.

questions.q: What did Yahweh do when Uzzah stretched out his hand to hold the Box of God after the oxen stumbled?
questions.a: Yahweh became very angry with Uzzah and killed him.

questions.q: Why was David angry with Yahweh?
questions.a: David was angry because Yahweh had punished Uzzah.

questions.q: Where did David put the Box of God when he became afraid of God?
questions.a: David put the Box of God into the house of Obed Edom the Gittite.

questions.q: What did Yahweh do for Obed Edom’s household?
questions.a: Yahweh blessed Obed Edom’s house and all that he possessed.

commentary.text: Verses 1–5 David said not, What magnificent thing shall I do now? or, What pleasant thing? but, What pious thing? that he might have the comfort and benefit of that sacred oracle. Let us bring the ark to us, that it may be a blessing to us. Those who honour God, profit themselves. It is the wisdom of those setting out in the world, to take God's ark with them. Those are likely to go on in the favour of God, who begin in the fear of God. (1Ch 13:6-14)

Let the sin of Uzza warn all to take heed of presumption, rashness, and irreverence, in dealing with holy things; and let none think that a good design will justify a bad action. Let the punishment of Uzza teach us not to dare to trifle with God in our approaches to him; yet let us, through Christ, come boldly to the throne of grace. If the gospel be to some a savour of death unto death, as the ark was to Uzza, yet let us receive it in the love of it, and it will be to us a savour of life unto life.
